split: Identical to prior affine experiment FOREST FIT sets: for test year Y, entries 2012..Y-3, outcomes before Y-2-01-01. Test entries Y. Previous calibration sets remain excluded from forest training; their labels are not used here. This isolates split weighting; it is not a full-history refit or June-2023 cutoff experiment.
fixed: 75 inputs; 32 trees, depth6, min_leaf10, min_groups5, min_events3 (all causes); q2 path budget, shared quantile cuts, 25 eligible features per tree, mtry75, 5 thresholds; same company bootstrap and seeds; native missingness; unweighted leaf AJ and equal tree averaging
changed: Only nonnegative cause weights in logrankCR split score; no outcome-dependent sample weighting
calibration: None; compare raw CIFs. No focal loss, clipping, posthoc slope fit, or threshold optimization
comparators: Reuse immutable same-fold unrestricted and randomForestSRC predictions; refit equal-weight q2 and verify exact reproduction of all 6 historical q2 models
primary: Equal three-seed prediction ensemble per variant; compute metrics on averaged predictions. Also report every seed; pooled AP recomputed on concatenated held-out forecasts
evaluation: Both causes: IPCW AUC/AP/Brier, risk mean and observed incidence; termination Top20/25 event coverage and calendar 3/6-month lead; q2 reconstruction/reload, native curve probability constraints, complexity, support and same-reference cross-seed stability
uncertainty: Only descriptive seed ranges, no significance claims or outcome-based model selection
resources: Two-node Slurm physical worker pool, NFS, one thread and 4GiB address-space limit per task, no GPU computation
limits: Train termination support only 2 and 4 events
Original financial/industry vintages not fully PIT certified
Announcement origin unchanged; same-day reports still excluded
Cause weighting is an established method, not a new independent algorithm contribution
privacy: Company rows, forecasts, forest parameters, actual thresholds and function values remain in private server storage
